messages.name: Cyberdyne Systems admin
messages.body: We're on Starter. Can we make a role that can create invoices but not see reports?

messages.name: Sam (Support)
messages.body: Custom roles are Enterprise only. Other plans use the four built-in roles: Admin, Accountant, Staff, and Read-only.

messages.name: Cyberdyne Systems admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
